'''1997 San Diego Comic-Con Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Anyone could enter, and the winner earned a seat at the World Championship.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open qualifier (United States)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 20 July 1997
* '''Site:''' San Diego Comic-Con, San Diego, California

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Clayton Atkin calls Evan Ferguson 'the 97 ComicCon champ', but the List records Paul Todd Feldman as winner of the 1997 San Diego Comic-Con Open.<ref name="tr-d1026">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkind1026/ 2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkin], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 23 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkind1026/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
